summary: George Risk Industries filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting that on September 14, 2026 the board declared a cash dividend on its Class A common stock, with the press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. The same release reported quarterly net sales of $6,850,000 for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, up 16.14% year over year, net income of $2,192,000 and EPS of $0.45, plus fiscal 2026 sales growth of 10.27%. No dividend per-share amount, record date, payment date or premium is stated in the excerpt; shares trade OTC Pink under RSKIA. Watch for the specific dividend terms and ex-date mechanics.
